name: Final Prayer doubles Testament healing (#2596)
contract: Final Prayer 705268 doubles Testament healing two ways: a +100% SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 on Testament of Fortitude (500678), whose first effect restores 5% of maximum health per tick, and SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_RECEIVED at +100% on the Testament of Faith mask. The core applies the second one in Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken, and only when the healer is the unit that cast the aura, which matches the talent's wording 'healing done to you'. The harness measures the healing done by a caster, not the amount a victim receives, so that effect is proved by the applied aura amount.
